results.content:
According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%.
results.title: A new low for Trump approval rating triggered by ongoing war with Iran

results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. [...] At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net approval rating of -10. results.content: President Donald Trump's net approval rating has slipped into negative territory in eleven states Trump carried by at least ten points in 2024 — a shift that pushes his political challenges well past the handful of battlegrounds where erosion was already expected.
